# Jeremiah 44 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 44:17 (overlap: 12%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | But we-will-certainly-do everything which has-gone-forth from-our-mouth, to-burn-incense to the-queen-of [the]-heavens and-to-pour-out to-her drink-offerings, as we did — we and-our-fathers, our-kings and-our-princes — in-[the]-cities-of Judah and-in-[the]-streets-of Jerusalem, and-we-were-satisfied [with]-bread and-were-good, and-evil we-did-not-see." |
| LOGOS | But we will do everything that we have vowed, make offerings to the queen of heaven and pour out drink offerings to her, as we did, both we and our fathers, our kings and our officials, in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem. For then we had plenty of food, and prospered, and saw no disaster." |
| PNEUMA | We will do whatever we want! We will burn incense and pour out liquid offerings to the Queen of Heaven just as we and our ancestors, kings, and officials have always done in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem. Back then we had plenty to eat and were well off and had no troubles!" |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
